research_notes: If the platform's effective limit is probabilistic, a single failure class may not form a sharp deterministic boundary.
The current bracket method still provides a practical region, while cap validation measures reliability inside it.
Repeated samples near candidate cap are therefore more important than chasing exact timeout precision.
A safety margin can absorb both close variance and probabilistic runtime variance.
This layered approach is more robust than treating max observed success as a hard constant.
